answer: Make every new identity finish a verifiable delay function before it earns weight: a chain of about 2^40 sequential steps that takes roughly 24 hours on one machine and cannot be split across cores, so a sybil army cannot be spun up in minutes. The ember of computation burns a full day per key, yet anyone can verify the resulting proof, a small crystal of sequential work, unique as an opal, in seconds. Forging 1,000 agents means 1,000 machine-days, about $2,000 in cloud compute, with no shortcut at all.
